```python
from seedemu import Emulator, Layer
from seedemu.core import AutonomousSystem, Network, Router, Host, InternetExchange
from seedemu.services import WebService

# Initialize emulator and layers
emu = Emulator()
core_layer = Layer()
routing_layer = Layer()
service_layer = Layer()

# Create Internet Exchange
ix = InternetExchange(100)
ix.setDisplayName("IX-100")
ix.setDescription("Internet Exchange 100 for peering ASes")
core_layer.addVertex(ix)

# Create three Autonomous Systems
as_ids = [65001, 65002, 65003]
ases = []
for i, asn in enumerate(as_ids):
    # Create AS
    asys = AutonomousSystem(asn)
    asys.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn}")
    asys.setDescription(f"Autonomous System {asn}")
    core_layer.addVertex(asys)
    ases.append(asys)

    # Create two networks per AS
    net1 = Network(f"net{asn}_1")
    net1.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn} Network 1")
    net1.setDescription(f"First network in AS{asn}")
    net2 = Network(f"net{asn}_2")
    net2.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn} Network 2")
    net2.setDescription(f"Second network in AS{asn}")
    core_layer.addVertex(net1)
    core_layer.addVertex(net2)
    asys.addVertex(net1)
    asys.addVertex(net2)

    # Create router joining both networks
    router = Router(f"r{asn}")
    router.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn} Router")
    router.setDescription(f"Router for AS{asn} connecting two networks")
    core_layer.addVertex(router)
    asys.addVertex(router)
    router.joinNetwork(net1)
    router.joinNetwork(net2)

    # Create host joining net1
    host = Host(f"h{asn}")
    host.setDisplayName(f"AS{asn} Host")
    host.setDescription(f"Host in AS{asn} on Network 1")
    core_layer.addVertex(host)
    asys.addVertex(host)
    host.joinNetwork(net1)

    # Install web service on a virtual node and bind to host
    web_service = WebService()
    vnode = service_layer.createNode(f"web{asn}")
    service_layer.install(web_service, vnode)
    service_layer.bind(vnode, host)

# Peer all ASes with the Internet Exchange
for asys in ases:
    asys.joinInternetExchange(ix)

# Add layers to emulator
emu.addLayer(core_layer)
emu.addLayer(routing_layer)
emu.addLayer(service_layer)

# Render and compile with Docker, enabling internet map
emu.render()
emu.compile(Docker(), enableInternetMap=True)
```
